candidate.name: Muhammad Rayyan Ahmed
credentials: M.Sc. Data Science (in progress), TU Ilmenau

letter.role_title: Working Student IT Project Management in Business Solutions – Public Markets Back Office
letter.opening: I am applying for the Working Student position in IT Project Management in Business Solutions. Supporting business systems and the people who use them is what I did every day in my previous role, and I would like to bring that to financial systems.
letter.profile_intro: I am an M.Sc. Data Science student at TU Ilmenau with four SAP Certified Associate certifications. I worked as a Business Analyst at Tapal Tea and in SAP data and analytics at TallyMarks Consulting.

achievements.impact: I handled daily support tickets and user queries for around 30 SAP Analytics Cloud dashboards across HR, finance, supply chain and procurement
in the SAP Young Professionals Program I trained on SAP Activate methodology and Fit-to-Standard workshops
I was part of a team migrating 42 dashboards from SAP BW to SAP Datasphere

letter.problems_section: I would help track project tasks, coordinate with users and IT, prepare documentation and keep the team's Office tools organised. I have not used SimCorp Dimension, and I would learn it and your asset management processes quickly.
letter.closing: I am willing to relocate to Munich and can work 16 or 20 hours per week for the full period you need, starting immediately. I would be glad to discuss the role.
letter.language_closing: I work in English (IELTS 8.0) and am currently learning German (A1).
